title: Noise action on a monomial
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. For every subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the expectation of the $S$-monomial after independently retaining each coordinate of $x$ with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and otherwise flipping its sign is $\rho^{|S|}$ times the $S$-monomial of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the coordinates
